nodes.statement:
Let $\alpha:M\to N$ be a homomorphism of $R$-modules, with $N$ finitely
generated.  If for every maximal ideal $\mathfrak m$ the induced map
$M/\mathfrak mM\to N/\mathfrak mN$ is surjective, then
$M_\mathfrak m\to N_\mathfrak m$ is surjective.  For coherent sheaves, if
the maps on all residue fibres are surjective, then the sheaf map is
surjective; if both sheaves are invertible, it is an isomorphism.
nodes.title: Exactness for locally free sheaves

nodes.statement:
Let $V$ be a complete variety over $k$ and let $\mathcal M$ be a locally free
sheaf.  For every field extension $K/k$, if $\mathcal M'$ is its pullback to
$V_K$, then
\[
\Gamma(V_K,\mathcal M')=\Gamma(V,\mathcal M)\otimes_kK.
\]
For a divisor $D$ on a smooth complete variety,
$L(D_K)=L(D)\otimes_kK$.
nodes.title: Cohomology after field extension

nodes.statement:
Let $V$ be complete and let $\mathcal L$ be locally free on $V$.  If
$\mathcal L$ becomes trivial after a field extension $K/k$, then it is
already trivial on $V$.
nodes.title: Relative fibre notation

nodes.statement:
Consider a regular map $V\to T$.  For $t\in T$, write
$V_t=V\times_k\operatorname{Specm}k(t)$ and write $\mathcal L_t$ for the
pullback of a sheaf $\mathcal L$ on $V\times T$ to $V_t$.
nodes.title: Fibrewise constancy criterion

nodes.statement:
Let $\alpha:V\to T$ be proper.  Then $\alpha_*\mathcal M$ is coherent for
every coherent sheaf $\mathcal M$ on $V$.  If $\mathcal L$ is invertible on
$V\times T$ with $V$ complete, then $t\mapsto\dim_{k(t)}\Gamma(V_t,\mathcal
L_t)$ is upper semicontinuous.  If it is constantly $n$, then $q_*\mathcal L$
is locally free of rank $n$ and the canonical map
$(q_*\mathcal L)(t)\to\Gamma(V_t,\mathcal L_t)$ is an isomorphism.
nodes.title: Seesaw reduction

nodes.statement:
Let $\mathfrak d$ be a complete linear system on a complete nonsingular variety
$V$, and let $\phi:V\dashrightarrow\PP^n$ be the rational map defined by
$\mathfrak d$.  Then $\phi$ is defined at $P$ if and only if $P$ is not a base
point of $\mathfrak d$.
nodes.title: Linear systems separate points

nodes.statement:
\begin{enumerate}
\item A linear system $\mathfrak d$ separates points if, for every pair of
points $P,Q\in V$, there is a $D\in\mathfrak d$ with
$P\in\operatorname{Supp}(D)$ and $Q\notin\operatorname{Supp}(D)$.
\item It separates tangent directions if, for every $P\in V$ and every
nonzero tangent vector $t$ at $P$, there is a divisor $D\in\mathfrak d$ with
$P\in D$ but $t\notin T_P(D)$.
\end{enumerate}
nodes.title: Separation by a linear system

nodes.statement:
Assume that $\mathfrak d$ has no base points.  Then the map
$\phi:V\to\PP^n$ defined by $\mathfrak d$ is a closed immersion if and only if
$\mathfrak d$ separates points and separates tangent directions.
nodes.title: Criterion for an embedding
Ample divisors on an abelian variety

nodes.statement:
For an invertible sheaf $\mathcal L$ on $A$, the class
$[t_a^*\mathcal L\otimes\mathcal L^{-1}]$ depends algebraically on $a$
and defines a homomorphism $\lambda_{\mathcal L}:A\to A^\vee$.
nodes.title: Dual correspondence of a line bundle

nodes.statement:
Assume that the finite group $G$ acts freely on $V$, and let $W=V/G$.  Then
$\mathcal M\mapsto\pi_*\mathcal M$ defines an equivalence from the category
of coherent $\mathcal O_W$-modules to the category of coherent $G$-sheaves on
$V$, under which locally free sheaves of rank $r$ correspond to locally free
sheaves of rank $r$.
nodes.title: Coherent sheaves on a finite quotient

nodes.statement: A polarization $\lambda$ of an abelian variety $A$ is an isogeny $\lambda:A\to A^\vee$ which over $k^{\rm al}$ is $\lambda_L$ for an ample sheaf $L$ on $A_{k^{\rm al}}$. Its degree is its degree as an isogeny. A polarized abelian variety is a pair $(A,\lambda)$; degree one gives a principal polarization.
nodes.title: Polarization

nodes.statement: Let $L$ be an invertible sheaf on $A$, and put $\chi(L)=\sum_i(-1)^i\dim_kH^i(A,L)$. Then (a) $\deg(\lambda_L)=\chi(L)^2$; (b) if $L=L(D)$, then $\chi(L)=(D^g)/g!$; (c) if $\dim K(L)=0$, then $H^r(A,L)$ is nonzero for exactly one integer $r$.
nodes.title: Riemann--Roch for abelian varieties

nodes.statement: If $k$ is finite and $g,d>0$, then up to isomorphism there are only finitely many abelian varieties $A/k$ of dimension $g$ possessing a polarization of degree $d^2$.
nodes.title: Finiteness over finite fields

nodes.statement: Let $A$ have dimension $g$ over a separably closed field $k$, and let $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$. There is a canonical isomorphism $H^1(A_{\rm et},\Z_\ell)\simeq\operatorname{Hom}_{\Z_\ell}(T_\ell A,\Z_\ell)$, and cup products give $\bigwedge^rH^1(A_{\rm et},\Z_\ell)\simeq H^r(A_{\rm et},\Z_\ell)$ for every $r$. In particular $H^r$ is free of rank $\binom{2g}{r}$.
nodes.title: Etale cohomology

nodes.statement: Let $H^*$ be a graded associative anticommutative algebra over a perfect field $K$, with $H^0=K$, vanishing above degree $d$, and a map $m^*$ satisfying $m^*(x)=x\otimes1+1\otimes x+\sum x_i\otimes y_i$ with positive degrees in the sum. Then $\dim H^1\le d$; equality implies that $H^*$ is canonically the exterior algebra on $H^1$.
nodes.title: Hopf algebra lemma

nodes.statement: If $m,n$ are prime to $\operatorname{char}(k)$, then $e_{mn}(a,a')^n=e_m(na,na')$ for $a\in A_{mn}(k)$ and $a'\in A^\vee_{mn}(k)$.
nodes.title: Compatibility of Weil pairings

nodes.statement: For $\alpha:A\to B$, $e_\ell(a,\alpha^\vee b)=e_\ell(\alpha a,b)$; $e_\ell^{\alpha^\vee\lambda\alpha}(a,a')=e_\ell^\lambda(\alpha a,\alpha a')$; and $e_\ell^{\alpha^*L}(a,a')=e_\ell^L(\alpha a,\alpha a')$. Moreover $L\mapsto e_\ell^L$ is a homomorphism $\Pic(A)\to\operatorname{Hom}(\bigwedge^2T_\ell A,\Z_\ell(1))$, so $e_\ell^L$ is skew-symmetric.
nodes.title: Functoriality of Weil pairings

nodes.statement: If $\alpha:A\to B$ is an isogeny of degree prime to $\operatorname{char}(k)$ and $\lambda\in\NS(A)$, then $\lambda=\alpha^*(\lambda')$ for some $\lambda'\in\NS(B)$ iff for every $\ell\mid\deg(\alpha)$ there is a skew-symmetric form $e$ on $T_\ell B$ with $e_\ell^\lambda(a,a')=e(\alpha a,\alpha a')$.
nodes.title: Descent of Neron--Severi classes

nodes.statement: For $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, $\lambda\in\NS(A)$ is divisible by $\ell^n$ iff $e_\ell^\lambda$ is divisible by $\ell^n$ in $\operatorname{Hom}(\bigwedge^2T_\ell A,\Z_\ell(1))$.
nodes.title: Divisibility criterion

nodes.statement: If $\operatorname{char}(k)\ne2$, a homomorphism $\lambda:A\to A^\vee$ is $\lambda_L$ for some $L\in\Pic(A)$ iff $e_\ell^\lambda$ is skew-symmetric.
nodes.title: Polarization from skew pairing

nodes.statement: For the Poincare sheaf $P$ on $A\times A^\vee$, $e_\ell^P((a,b),(a',b'))=e_\ell(a,b')e_\ell(a',b)^{-1}$.
nodes.title: Poincare pairing

nodes.statement: Let $\alpha:A\to B$ be an isogeny of degree prime to $\operatorname{char}(k)$ and $\lambda$ a polarization of $A$. Then $\lambda=\alpha^*\lambda'$ for a polarization $\lambda'$ on $B$ iff $\ker(\alpha)\subset\ker(\lambda)$ and $e^\lambda$ is trivial on $\ker(\alpha)\times\ker(\alpha)$.
nodes.title: Descent of a polarization

nodes.statement: An abelian variety with a polarization of degree prime to the characteristic is isogenous to a principally polarized abelian variety.
nodes.title: Principal polarization up to isogeny

nodes.statement: If $\ker(\lambda)\subset A_m$ with $m$ prime to the characteristic and $\alpha\in\End(A)$ preserves $\ker(\lambda)$ and satisfies $\alpha^\vee\lambda\alpha=\lambda$ on $A_{m^2}$, then $A\times A^\vee$ is principally polarized.
nodes.title: Zarhin auxiliary polarization

nodes.statement: For every abelian variety $A$, $(A\times A^\vee)^4$ is principally polarized.
nodes.title: Zarhin's trick

nodes.statement: Over a finite field, for each $g$ there are only finitely many isomorphism classes of abelian varieties of dimension $g$.
nodes.title: Finite-dimensional abelian varieties over finite fields

nodes.statement: For a polarization $\lambda$ on $A$, put $\alpha^\dagger=\lambda^{-1}\circ\alpha^\vee\circ\lambda$ on $\End(A)\otimes\Q$.
nodes.title: Rosati involution

nodes.statement: Over an algebraically closed field, $L\mapsto\lambda^{-1}\lambda_L$ identifies $\NS(A)\otimes\Q$ with the elements of $\End(A)\otimes\Q$ fixed by $\dagger$.
nodes.title: Neron--Severi classes and Rosati fixed points

nodes.statement: The form $(\alpha,\beta)\mapsto\Tr(\alpha\beta^\dagger)$ on $\End(A)\otimes\Q$ is positive definite. If $D$ defines $\lambda$, then $\Tr(\alpha\alpha^\dagger)=\frac{2g}{(D^g)}(D^{g-1}\cdot\alpha^*D)>0$ for $\alpha\ne0$.
nodes.title: Rosati positivity

nodes.statement: The automorphism group of $(A,\lambda)$ is finite. For $n\ge3$, an automorphism acting identically on $A_n(k^{\rm al})$ is the identity.
nodes.title: Automorphisms of polarized varieties

nodes.statement: If $\zeta$ is a root of unity and $\zeta=1+n\alpha$ for an algebraic integer $\alpha$ and integer $n\ge3$, then $\zeta=1$.
nodes.title: Root of unity lemma

nodes.statement:
Let $A$ be an abelian variety over a field $k$, and let $d$ be an integer.
Then there are only finitely many isomorphism classes of polarized abelian
varieties $(A,\lambda)$ with $\deg\lambda=d$.
nodes.title: Finitely many polarizations

nodes.statement: Let $E$ be a finite-dimensional semisimple $\Q$-algebra with involution, $R$ an order, and $L$ an $R^\times$-stable lattice under $x\mapsto u^\dagger xu$. For each $N$, the set $\{v\in L:\Norm(v)\le N\}/R^\times$ is finite.
nodes.title: Arithmetic orbit finiteness

nodes.statement: Up to isomorphism, an abelian variety has only finitely many direct factors.
nodes.title: Finitely many direct factors

nodes.statement: If $E$ is semisimple finite-dimensional over $\Q$ and $R$ an order, then the idempotents in $R$ form finitely many $R^\times$-conjugacy classes.
nodes.title: Integral idempotent orbits

nodes.statement: Let $G/\Q$ be reductive, $\Gamma\subset G(\Q)$ arithmetic, $G\to\GL(V)$ a representation, and $L$ a $\Gamma$-stable lattice. If $X$ is a closed $G$-orbit in $V$, then $L\cap X$ is a finite union of $\Gamma$-orbits.
nodes.title: Borel--Harish-Chandra orbit theorem

nodes.statement:
Let $S$ be a connected variety, let $\pi:V\to S$ be proper and flat with
geometrically connected fibres, let $\pi':V'\to S$ be a variety over $S$,
and let $\alpha:V\to V'$ be a morphism over $S$.  If the image of one fibre
$V_s$ in $V'_s$ is a single point, then $\alpha$ factors through $S$: there is
a map $\alpha':S\to V'$ with $\alpha=\alpha'\circ\pi$.
nodes.title: Rigidity lemma

nodes.statement:
\begin{enumerate}
\item Every morphism of families of abelian varieties carrying the zero
section into the zero section is a homomorphism.
\item The group structure on a family of abelian varieties is uniquely
determined by the choice of a zero section.
\item A family of abelian varieties is commutative.
\end{enumerate}
nodes.title: Families are group-homomorphic

nodes.statement:
Let $A$ be an abelian variety over a field $k$, and let $S$ be a variety over
$k$ such that $S(k)\ne\varnothing$.  For any injective homomorphism of
families $\alpha:B\hookrightarrow A\times S$ over $S$, there is an abelian
subvariety $B_0$ of $A$, defined over $k$, such that
$\alpha(B)=B_0\times S$.
nodes.title: Constant-family subvarieties

nodes.statement:
Let $K$ be a regular extension of a field $k$.
\begin{enumerate}
\item Let $A$ be an abelian variety over $k$.  Then every abelian subvariety
of $A_K$ is defined over $k$.
\item If $A$ and $B$ are abelian varieties over $k$, then every homomorphism
$A_K\to B_K$ is defined over $k$.
\end{enumerate}
nodes.title: Regular extensions

nodes.statement:
Let $K/k$ be a regular extension of fields and let $A$ be an abelian variety
over $K$.  Then there exist an abelian variety $B$ over $k$ and a
homomorphism $\alpha:B_K\to A$ with finite kernel such that, for every
abelian variety $B'$ over $k$ and every homomorphism
$\alpha':B'_K\to A$ with finite kernel, there is a unique homomorphism
$\varphi:B'\to B$ with $\alpha'=\alpha\circ\varphi_K$.
nodes.title: $K/k$-trace

nodes.statement: If $K$ is finitely generated over the prime field and $A/K$ is abelian, then $A(K)$ is finitely generated.
nodes.title: Mordell--Weil

nodes.statement: If $K/k$ is finitely generated with $k$ algebraically closed in $K$, and $(B,\alpha)$ is the $K/k$-trace of $A$, then $A(K)/\alpha(B)(k)$ is finitely generated.
nodes.title: Lang--Neron

nodes.statement:
Let $R$ be a discrete valuation ring with fraction field $K$ and residue field
$k$, and let $A$ be an abelian variety over $K$.  There is a canonical way
to attach to $A$ an algebraic group $A^0$ over $k$.
nodes.title: Neron model special fibre

nodes.statement:
If $A$ has good reduction, then $A^0$ does not change under a finite field
extension.  If $A$ has semistable reduction, then $(A^0)^0$ does not change
under a finite field extension.  Every abelian variety acquires semistable
reduction after a finite extension.
nodes.title: Semistable reduction

nodes.statement: For a compact Riemann surface $C$ of genus $g$, the holomorphic differentials form a $g$-dimensional complex vector space.
nodes.title: Holomorphic differentials

nodes.statement:
Let $\omega_1,\ldots,\omega_g$ be a basis of the holomorphic differentials
on a compact Riemann surface $C$, and let $\gamma_1,\ldots,\gamma_{2g}$ be
the standard basis of $H_1(C,\Z)$.  The period vectors
\[
\pi_j=\left(\int_{\gamma_j}\omega_1,\ldots,
\int_{\gamma_j}\omega_g\right)\in\C^g
\]
are linearly independent over $\R$.
nodes.title: Independence of periods

nodes.statement:
Let $\ell:\Omega(C)\to\C$ be a linear map.  Then there exist points
$P_1,\ldots,P_g$ on $C$ and paths $\gamma_i$ from a fixed point $P$ to
$P_i$ such that
\[
\ell(\omega)=\sum_{i=1}^g\int_{\gamma_i}\omega
\qquad\text{for all }\omega\in\Omega(C).
\]
nodes.title: Jacobi inversion

nodes.statement:
Let $P_1,\ldots,P_r$ and $Q_1,\ldots,Q_r$ be points of $C$, not
necessarily distinct.  There is a meromorphic function on $C$ with poles
exactly at the $P_i$ and zeros exactly at the $Q_i$ if and only if, for every
choice of paths $\gamma_i$ from $P$ to $P_i$ and $\gamma_i'$ from $P$ to
$Q_i$, there is a $\gamma\in H_1(C,\Z)$ such that
\[
\sum_i\int_{\gamma_i}\omega-\sum_i\int_{\gamma_i'}\omega
 =\int_{\gamma}\omega
\qquad\text{for all }\omega\in\Omega(C).
\]
nodes.title: Abel's theorem

nodes.statement:
Put
\[
J=\Omega(C)^\vee/H_1(C,\Z),
\]
where $H_1(C,\Z)$ is embedded by integration.  The intersection product
\[
H_1(C,\Z)\times H_1(C,\Z)\longrightarrow\Z
\]
is a Riemann form on $J$; hence $J$ is an abelian variety.  Fixing $P\in C$,
the map
\[
\sum_i n_iP_i\longmapsto\left(\omega\longmapsto
\sum_i n_i\int_P^{P_i}\omega\right):\Div^0(C)\longrightarrow J
\]
is surjective with kernel the principal divisors, and therefore induces an
isomorphism $\Pic^0(C)\simeq J$.
nodes.title: Jacobian from periods

nodes.statement: Assume $C(k)\ne\varnothing$. The functor $P_C^0$ of families of invertible sheaves of degree zero on $C$, modulo pullback from the parameter, is represented by an abelian variety $J$, uniquely determined up to unique isomorphism, called the Jacobian variety of $C$.
nodes.title: Jacobian representability when pointed

nodes.statement: For $P\in C(k)$ and $J=\operatorname{Jac}(C)$ there is a divisorial correspondence $M$ on $C\times J$ universal as follows: for every divisorial correspondence $L$ on $C\times T$ from $(C,P)$ to a pointed variety $(T,t)$, whose fibres on $C$ have degree zero, there is a unique pointed regular map $\varphi:T\to J$ with $(1\times\varphi)^*M\simeq L$.
nodes.title: Universal divisorial correspondence

nodes.statement: For a nonsingular curve $C$, the symmetric power $C^{(r)}$ is nonsingular.
nodes.title: Smoothness of symmetric powers

nodes.statement: There is an abelian variety $J/k$ and a morphism of functors $\iota:P_C^0\to J$ such that $\iota:P_C^0(T)\to J(T)$ is an isomorphism whenever $C(T)\ne\varnothing$. The pair $(J,\iota)$ is uniquely determined up to unique isomorphism, and after any extension over which $C$ has a rational point it identifies $P_C^0$ with $J$.
nodes.title: Jacobian over an arbitrary field

nodes.statement: If $P\in C(k)$, there is a divisorial correspondence $M_P$ between $(C,P)$ and $J$ such that, for every divisorial correspondence $L$ between $(C,P)$ and a pointed $k$-scheme $(T,t)$, there is a unique pointed morphism $\varphi:T\to J$ satisfying $(1\times\varphi)^*M_P\simeq L$.
nodes.title: Pointed universal property

nodes.statement: Theorem~\ref{thm:milne-jacobian-general} implies Theorem~\ref{thm:milne-jacobian-pointed}.
nodes.title: Pointed property from representability

nodes.statement: For a finite Galois extension $k'/k$ with group $G$, base change gives an equivalence between quasi-projective $k$-varieties and quasi-projective $k'$-varieties with descent datum. It likewise gives an equivalence between coherent sheaves, and a descended sheaf is locally free when its pullback is locally free.
nodes.title: Descent of varieties and coherent sheaves

nodes.statement: Let $k'/k$ be finite separable. If Theorem~\ref{thm:milne-jacobian-general} holds for $C_{k'}$, then it holds for $C$.
nodes.title: Descent of the Jacobian

nodes.statement: The tangent space at zero is canonically $T_0J\simeq H^1(C,\mathcal O_C)$; consequently $\dim J$ is the genus of $C$.
nodes.title: Tangent space of the Jacobian

nodes.statement: For $P\in C(k)$, $f^P:C\to J$ induces an isomorphism $f^{P*}:H^0(J,\Omega_J^1)\to H^0(C,\Omega_C^1)$.
nodes.title: Differentials of the Abel map

nodes.statement: For $g(C)>0$, $f^P:C\to J$ is a closed immersion.
nodes.title: The Abel map is a closed immersion

nodes.statement: If $V$ is complete over an algebraically closed field, $f:V\to W$ is injective on points and injective on every tangent space, then $f$ is a closed immersion.
nodes.title: Complete tangent-injective map criterion

nodes.statement: For $k=\C$, the canonical surjection $e:H^0(C,\Omega_C^1)^\vee\twoheadrightarrow J(\C)$ induces an isomorphism $H^0(C,\Omega_C^1)^\vee/H_1(C,\Z)\simeq J(\C)$ carrying the analytic Abel map to $f^P$.
nodes.title: Analytic Jacobian

nodes.statement: For every variety $V/k$ there is a variety $V^{(r)}$ and a symmetric map $\pi:V^r\to V^{(r)}$ whose underlying topological space is the quotient by $S_r$, with $U^{(r)}$ affine for every affine open $U\subset V$ and coordinate ring $\Gamma(U^r,\mathcal O)^{S_r}$. Every symmetric morphism factors uniquely through $\pi$; $\pi$ is finite, surjective, and separable.
nodes.title: Symmetric power of a variety

nodes.statement: If $C$ is a nonsingular curve, then $C^{(r)}$ is nonsingular.
nodes.title: Smoothness of symmetric powers

nodes.statement: For $\pi:X\to T$, a relative effective Cartier divisor is an effective Cartier divisor whose associated closed subspace is flat over $T$.
nodes.title: Relative effective Cartier divisor

nodes.statement: The sum of two relative effective divisors on $X/T$ is relative effective.
nodes.title: Sum of relative effective divisors

nodes.statement: The pullback of a relative effective divisor under any base change is a relative effective divisor.
nodes.title: Base change of relative divisors

nodes.statement: If $D,X$ are flat over $T$ and every fibre $D_t$ is an effective divisor on $X_t$, then $D$ is a relative effective divisor on $X/T$.
nodes.title: Fibrewise Cartier criterion

nodes.statement: For a proper smooth relative curve $C/T$, a closed subspace $D$ is a relative effective divisor iff it is finite and flat over $T$. A section has degree-one image.
nodes.title: Finite flat divisors on a smooth curve family

nodes.statement: If relative effective divisors satisfy $D_t\ge D'_t$ for every $t\in T$, then $D\ge D'$.
nodes.title: Fibrewise containment of divisors

nodes.statement: If the support of a relative effective divisor $D$ on $C/T$ is a union of sections, then $D$ has a unique expression $D=\sum_i n_i s_i(T)$.
nodes.title: Split relative divisors

nodes.statement: For every relative effective divisor $D$ on $C\times T/T$ of degree $r$, there is a unique morphism $\varphi:T\to C^{(r)}$ with $D=(1\times\varphi)^*D_{\rm can}$. Thus $C^{(r)}$ represents the functor $\operatorname{Div}_C^r$.
nodes.title: Representability of effective divisors

nodes.statement: For $r>2g$, if the natural map $f:\operatorname{Div}_C^r\to P_C^r$ has a section, then $P_C^r$ is represented by a closed subscheme of $C^{(r)}$.
nodes.title: A section gives representability

nodes.statement: For an $(r-g)$-tuple $\mathbf P$ of rational points and $L_{\mathbf P}=L(\sum P_i)$, there is an open $C_{\mathbf P}\subset C^{(r)}$ parametrizing divisors $D$ with $h^0(D-\sum P_i)=1$. The corresponding subfunctor $P_{\mathbf P}\subset P_C^r$ is represented locally, and $\operatorname{Div}_{\mathbf P}^r\to P_{\mathbf P}$ has a section.
nodes.title: Local sections of the divisor map

nodes.statement: The functor $P_{\mathbf P}$ is represented by a closed subvariety of $C_{\mathbf P}$.
nodes.title: Local Jacobian charts

nodes.statement: For $r\le g$, $f^{(r)}:C^{(r)}\to W^r$ is birational, and $f^{(g)}:C^{(g)}\dashrightarrow J$ is birational. If $D$ is effective and $F$ is its fibre, then $0\to T_DF\to T_D C^{(r)}\to T_{f^{(r)}(D)}J$ is exact.
nodes.title: Fibres and tangent map of the Abel map

nodes.statement: If $h^1(D)>0$, there is a nonempty open subset of $C$ on which adding a point lowers $h^1$ by one and outside which it does not. Consequently, for $r\le g$ there is an open subset of $C^r$ on which $h^0(\sum P_i)=1$.
nodes.title: Generic addition of points

nodes.statement: There are canonical isomorphisms $H^0(C,\Omega_C^1)\simeq H^0(C^r,\Omega^1)^{S_r}\simeq H^0(C^{(r)},\Omega^1)$. Under these identifications, $f^{(r)*}:H^0(J,\Omega_J^1)\to H^0(C^{(r)},\Omega^1)$ is an isomorphism, and a differential has a zero at $D$ precisely when its pullback to $C^{(r)}$ vanishes at $D$.
nodes.title: Differentials on symmetric powers

nodes.statement: If $\sigma_i$ are the elementary symmetric functions in $X_1,\ldots,X_r$ and $\tau_j=\sum_iX_i^j,dX_i$, then $\sigma_0\tau_0-\sigma_1\tau_1+\cdots+(-1)^m\sigma_m\tau_m=d\sigma_{m+1}$ for $m\le r-1$.
nodes.title: Symmetric differential identity

nodes.statement: For $r\le g$, the map $f^r:C^r\to W^r$ has degree $r!$.
nodes.title: Degree of the ordered Abel map

nodes.statement: For $P\in C(k)$, every map $\varphi:C\to A$ to an abelian variety with $\varphi(P)=0$ factors uniquely as $\varphi=\alpha\circ f^P$ for a homomorphism $\alpha:J\to A$.
nodes.title: Albanese universal property

nodes.statement: If $N$ is a divisorial correspondence between $(C,P)$ and $J$ with $(1\times f^P)^*N\simeq L_P$, then $N\simeq M_P$.
nodes.title: Uniqueness of the universal correspondence

nodes.statement: For pointed curves $(C_i,P_i)$ with Jacobians $J_i$, there is a bijection between $\operatorname{Hom}_k(J_1,J_2)$ and isomorphism classes of divisorial correspondences between $(C_1,P_1)$ and $(C_2,P_2)$.
nodes.title: Correspondences and homomorphisms

nodes.statement: For every map $\varphi:C\times C\to A$ with $\varphi(\Delta)=0$, there is a unique homomorphism $\alpha:J\to A$ with $\alpha\circ F=\varphi$, where $F(P_1,P_2)=f^P(P_1)-f^P(P_2)$; this $F$ is defined over $k$ even when $C(k)=\varnothing$.
nodes.title: Albanese factorization without a point

nodes.statement: If $\Theta=W^{g-1}$ (translated as necessary), then $\varphi_{L(\Theta)}:J\to J^\vee$ is an isomorphism. Hence $J$ has a canonical principal polarization.
nodes.title: Canonical principal polarization

nodes.statement: On the largest open set where $f^{(g)}$ has zero-dimensional fibres represented by sums of distinct points, $f^{-1}(\Theta_a)$ is the effective divisor representing the unique degree-$g$ divisor $D(a)$ mapping to $a$; its degree is at most $g$.
nodes.title: Inverse image of a theta divisor

nodes.statement: For every $a\in J(k)$, if $f^{(g)}(D)=a$, then $f^*L(\Theta_a)\simeq L(D)$. Moreover $(f\times(-1))^*L'(\Theta)\simeq M_P$ on $C\times J$.
nodes.title: Poincare sheaf comparison

nodes.statement: The homomorphism $f^\vee:J^\vee\to J$ defined by $(f\times1)^*P\simeq(1\times f^\vee)^*M_P$ is inverse to $\varphi_{L(\Theta)}$.
nodes.title: Autoduality inverse

nodes.statement: For a pointed curve $(C,P)$ of genus $g$, there are open subsets $U,V\subset C^{(g)}\times C^{(g)}$ such that $h^0(D+D'-gP)=1$ on $U$ and $h^0(D'-D+gP)=1$ on $V$.
nodes.title: Generic Riemann--Roch divisors

nodes.statement: There is a unique rational map $m:C^{(g)}\times C^{(g)}\dashrightarrow C^{(g)}$ defined on $U$ with $m(D,D')\sim D+D'-gP$; it makes $C^{(g)}$ a birational group.
nodes.title: Birational group law on $C^{(g)}$

nodes.statement: For every birational group $V/k$ there is a group variety $G/k$ and a birational map $f:V\dashrightarrow G$ with $f(ab)=f(a)f(b)$ wherever defined; $G$ is unique up to unique isomorphism.
nodes.title: Birational group completion

nodes.statement: The group variety $J$ obtained from the birational group $C^{(g)}$ is complete.
nodes.title: Completeness of Weil's Jacobian

nodes.statement: The rational map $f:C^{(g)}\dashrightarrow J$ is a morphism. Linearly equivalent divisors over any extension field have the same image in $J$.
nodes.title: Extension of the rational map

nodes.statement: There is a canonical isomorphism of functors $P_C^0\simeq J$.
nodes.title: Weil construction represents the Picard functor

nodes.statement:
Let $C\to S$ be a proper flat curve with integral fibres.  There
is a group scheme $\mathcal J$ with connected fibres and a morphism of functors
$P^0_{C/S}\to\mathcal J$ that is injective and is an isomorphism whenever
$C\times_S T\to T$ has a section.  The construction commutes with base change.
If $C/S$ is smooth, $\mathcal J$ is an abelian scheme, and its fibre at $t$ is
the Jacobian of $C_t$.
nodes.title: Relative Jacobian

nodes.statement:
If $\mathcal E$ is locally free and $\operatorname{Grass}_{\mathcal E}^n(T)$
classifies rank-$n$ locally free quotients of $\mathcal O_T\otimes\mathcal E$,
then this functor is represented by a projective variety $G_{\mathcal E}^n/S$.
nodes.title: Grassmann representability

nodes.statement:
For $r>2g-2$ and $m>2g-2+r$, the map sending a relative effective divisor
$D$ to the quotient $q_*\mathcal O_D(m)$ identifies $\operatorname{Div}^r_{C/S}$
with a closed subscheme of the appropriate Grassmann scheme.  The fibres of
$\operatorname{Div}^r_{C/S}\to P^r_{C/S}$ are projective-space bundles.
nodes.title: Divisors in a Grassmannian

nodes.statement:
Let $C/k$ be a complete nonsingular pointed curve with Jacobian $J$, over a
separably closed field.  Pullback along the Abel map induces an isomorphism
$\pi_1(C,P)^{\mathrm{ab}}\simeq\pi_1(J,0)$; hence every connected abelian
etale cover of $C$ is the pullback of a connected etale cover of $J$.
nodes.title: Abelian coverings

nodes.statement:
For a complete nonsingular $V$ and $n$ prime to the characteristic,
$\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathrm{cont}}(\pi_1(V,P),\mathbb Z/n\mathbb Z)
\simeq\Pic(V)[n]$.  The map sends an $n$-torsion divisor class to the unramified Kummer
cover obtained by adjoining an $n$th root of a representative function.
nodes.title: Kummer characters

nodes.statement: The Abel map induces $\Pic^0(J)\simeq\Pic^0(C)$.
nodes.title: Picard comparison for the Abel map

nodes.statement:
For $p=\operatorname{char}(k)$,
$\operatorname{Hom}(\pi_1(V,P),\mathbb Z/p\mathbb Z)
\simeq\ker(1-F:H^1(V,\mathcal O_V)\to H^1(V,\mathcal O_V))$.
nodes.title: Characteristic-$p$ characters

nodes.statement: The Abel map gives $H^1(J,\mathcal O_J)\simeq H^1(C,\mathcal O_C)$.
nodes.title: Structure sheaf comparison

nodes.statement:
For every prime $\ell$, $H^1_{\et}(J,\mathbb Z_\ell)\to
H^1_{\et}(C,\mathbb Z_\ell)$ induced by the Abel map is an isomorphism.
nodes.title: Etale cohomology comparison

nodes.statement:
If $C'\to C$ is a finite abelian cover unramified outside $\Sigma$, there is
a modulus $\mathfrak m$ supported on $\Sigma$ and an etale isogeny
$J'\to J_{\mathfrak m}$ whose pullback by the canonical map is
$C'\setminus f^{-1}(\Sigma)$.
nodes.title: Ramified coverings and generalized Jacobians

nodes.statement:
For a genus-$g$ curve over a number field with good reduction outside $S$,
there is an extension $k'/k$ of degree at most $2^{2g}$, unramified outside
$S$, and a cover $C_P\to C_{k'}$ of degree at most
$2^{2g(g-1)+2g+1}$, ramified exactly over a chosen rational point $P$,
with $C_P$ having good reduction outside $S$.
nodes.title: Parshin's auxiliary cover

nodes.statement:
For fixed $k,g,S$, only finitely many isomorphism classes of genus-$g$ smooth
complete curves over $k$ have good reduction outside $S$.
nodes.title: Shafarevich

nodes.statement:
If Shafarevich's conjecture holds, then every curve of genus at least two over
a number field has finitely many rational points.
nodes.title: Shafarevich implies Mordell

nodes.statement: Every abelian variety over an infinite field is a quotient of a Jacobian.
nodes.title: Jacobian quotient

nodes.statement:
If $\pi:W\to V$ is finite and $\mathcal L$ is ample on complete $V$, then
$\pi^*\mathcal L$ is ample on $W$.
nodes.title: Finite pullback preserves ampleness

nodes.statement:
If $V$ is nonsingular projective of dimension at least two and $Z$ is a
general hyperplane section in a projective embedding, then inverse images of
$Z$ under a finite map from a nonsingular $W$ are geometrically connected.
nodes.title: Finite fibres of a general projection

nodes.statement:
If $C/\mathbb F_q$ is complete nonsingular and the Frobenius polynomial of
$J_C$ is $P(X)=\prod_i(X-a_i)$, then
$\#C(\mathbb F_q)=1+q-\sum_i a_i$ and
$|\#C(\mathbb F_q)-q-1|\le 2gq^{1/2}$; the roots $a_i$ have absolute value
$q^{1/2}$.
nodes.title: Point count from Frobenius

nodes.statement:
For an endomorphism $\alpha$ of $C$ and its induced endomorphism of $J$,
the intersection number satisfies $(\Gamma_\alpha\cdot\Delta)=1-\operatorname{Tr}(\alpha)+\deg(\alpha)$.
nodes.title: Correspondence trace formula

nodes.statement:
For $A/k$ of dimension $g$ and a divisor $H$, with $D_\alpha=(\alpha+1)^*H-\alpha^*H-H$,
\[
\operatorname{Tr}(\alpha)=g\frac{(H^{g-1}\cdot D_\alpha)}{(H^g)}.
\]
nodes.title: Weil polynomial identity

nodes.statement:
\[
Z(C,t)=\frac{P(t)}{(1-t)(1-qt)},\qquad
P(t)=\prod_i(1-a_i t).
\]
nodes.title: Curve zeta function

nodes.statement:
For complete nonsingular curves $C,C'$ over an algebraically closed field,
an isomorphism $\beta$ of their canonically principally polarized Jacobians
induces an isomorphism $\alpha:C\simeq C'$ and a sign
$\varepsilon\in\{1,-1\}$ such that
$f'\alpha=\varepsilon\beta f+c$ for some translation $c$.  If $g(C)\ge2$
and $C$ is not hyperelliptic, $\alpha,\varepsilon,c$ are uniquely determined;
if $C$ is hyperelliptic, $\alpha,c$ are uniquely determined for each choice of
$\varepsilon$.
nodes.title: Torelli

nodes.statement:
If two genus-$\ge2$ curves over a perfect field have isomorphic canonically
polarized Jacobians over that field, then the curves are isomorphic over it.
nodes.title: Torelli over a perfect field

nodes.statement:
For fixed $k,g,S$, the polarized-Jacobian map injects curves of genus $g\ge2$
with good reduction outside $S$ into principally polarized abelian varieties
with good reduction outside $S$.
nodes.title: Torelli finiteness

nodes.statement:
Finiteness of principally polarized abelian varieties of fixed dimension and
good reduction outside $S$ implies Mordell's conjecture.
nodes.title: Torelli and Mordell

nodes.statement:
For $0\le r\le g-1$, $W_a^r\subset W_b^{g-1}$ iff
$a\in W_b^{g-1-r}$.
nodes.title: Theta incidence criterion

nodes.statement:
For $0\le r\le g-1$,
\[
W^{g-1-r}=\bigcap_{a\in W^r}W_a^{g-1},\qquad
(W^{g-1-r})^*=\bigcap_{a\in W^r}(W_a^{g-1})^*.
\]
nodes.title: Theta intersections

nodes.statement:
If $a+x=b+y$ with $x\in W^1$, $y\in W^{g-1-r}$ and
$W_a^{r+1}\not\subset W_b^{g-1}$, then
$W_a^{r+1}\cap W_b^{g-1}=W_{a+x}^r\cup S$, where
$S=W_a^{r+1}\cap(W_{y-a}^{g-2})^*$.
nodes.title: Generic theta intersection decomposition

nodes.statement:
If $a\in J(k)$ and $W^1\not\subset W_a^{g-1}$, then the intersection is the
effective divisor $D(a)$ of degree $g$ with $f(D(a))=a+\kappa$.
nodes.title: Theta divisor recovers the Abel curve
